text: My vehicle was finance with Wells Fargo. A year and XXXX into my auto loan Wells Fargo called me and stated because of my timely payments They would like to offer me a {$5000.00} dollar personal loan. I did except the Loan not knowing that they would put a Loan on top of a Loan. After 5 years of paying my auto Loan I was told I had another 2 years into paying my Auto Loan off which the {$5000.00} added on to my original Loan. Wells Fargo Repossessed my vehicle and told me I owed them {$12000.00}.
